title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 23: the last words of David and the brave deeds of his mighty men.

questions.text: How is David described in the opening verse of his last words?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:1 calls David the son of Jesse, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel.

questions.text: One who rules over men righteously shall be like what?
questions.explanation: The one who rules righteously in the fear of God shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises.

questions.text: What will all the ungodly be like, according to 2 Samuel 23:6?
questions.explanation: The verse says all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can't be taken with the hand.

questions.text: How many men did Josheb Basshebeth, called Adino the Eznite, kill at one time?
questions.explanation: Josheb Basshebeth, chief of the captains, was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

questions.text: What happened to Eleazar's hand as he struck the Philistines?
questions.explanation: Eleazar the son of Dodai struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword.

answers.text: It was wounded by an arrow
His sword broke in his hand
It grew weary and froze to the sword

questions.text: What kind of plot of ground did Shammah defend against the Philistines?
questions.explanation: The Philistines gathered where there was a plot of ground full of lentils, and Shammah stood in the middle of it and defended it.

questions.text: What did David long for while the Philistines held Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: While the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem, David longed for water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate.

answers.text: Bread from the ovens of Hebron
Wine from the vineyards of Judah
Water from the well of Bethlehem by the gate
Figs from the trees of Jericho

questions.text: What did David do with the water the three mighty men brought him?
questions.explanation: David would not drink it, but poured it out to Yahweh, saying it was the blood of the men who risked their lives.

answers.text: He poured it out to Yahweh
He drank it all at once
He shared it with the soldiers

questions.text: Where and when did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada kill a lion?
questions.explanation: Benaiah went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

answers.text: On a mountain in the summer heat
In a pit in a time of snow
In a vineyard at harvest time
At the gate of Bethlehem at night

questions.text: Who is the last man named in the list of David's mighty men?
questions.explanation: The list ends with Uriah the Hittite, followed by the words "thirty-seven in all."
